name: Nagi
source:
Another shinigami trainee, however her personality is the polar opposite of [url=/c11668]Hikaru[/url]'s. 
Nagi is a member of the Mechanical Club and she is good at robot building.
She works part-time in a bakery.
translation:
Another shinigami trainee, however her personality is the polar opposite of [url=/c11668]Hikaru[/url]'s. 
Nagi is a member of the Mechanical Club and she is good at robot building.
She works part-time in a bakery.
